about.heading: About VIKASDHARA FOUNDATION
about.copy:
VIKASDHARA FOUNDATION is a public charitable trust established with a vision of contributing to education, skills, employment, humanitarian support, care and sustainable community development.

The Foundation aims to build practical programmes and partnerships that respond to community needs while maintaining accountability, dignity and responsible use of resources.

Our long-term vision is to grow from local initiatives into a broader platform for opportunity and social development across India.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.statement: To contribute to a stronger, more inclusive and self-reliant India where people have fair opportunities to learn, develop future-ready skills, earn with dignity, live safely and contribute to the flourishing of their communities and environment.
vision.statementMr: एका सक्षम, सर्वसमावेशक आणि आत्मनिर्भर भारताच्या उभारणीत योगदान देणे, जिथे प्रत्येक व्यक्तीला शिकण्याची, कौशल्ये विकसित करण्याची, सन्मानाने उपजीविका मिळवण्याची आणि समाजाच्या विकासात सहभागी होण्याची समान संधी मिळेल.

pillars.title: Inclusive & Future-Ready Education
pillars.desc: Ensuring every child and youth has access to foundational learning, digital literacy, and STEM resources regardless of socio-economic background.

pillars.title: Dignified Livelihoods & Decent Work
pillars.desc: Empowering youth and jobseekers with market-aligned vocational certifications, apprenticeship linkages, and sustainable self-employment pathways.

pillars.title: Women-Led Rural Transformation
pillars.desc: Fostering economic independence and leadership among rural women through self-help groups (SHGs), micro-enterprises, and financial literacy.

pillars.title: Grassroots Health & Nutritional Dignity
pillars.desc: Promoting preventive healthcare, maternal-child nutrition, menstrual hygiene, and compassionate elder care across underserved villages.

pillars.title: Ecological Care & Cow Sanctuaries
pillars.desc: Preserving indigenous cattle through cruelty-free Gau Shalas while revitalizing rural ecosystems via afforestation and water conservation.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.statement: To develop, implement, and support scalable charitable programmes that create practical education, skill, employment, livelihood, humanitarian, environmental, animal-welfare, and community-development opportunities for people and communities in need across India.
mission.statementMr: गरजू व्यक्ती आणि समुदायांसाठी शिक्षण, कौशल्य, रोजगार, उपजीविका, मानवतावादी मदत, पर्यावरण, प्राणी कल्याण आणि समुदाय विकासाच्या संधी निर्माण करणारे व्यावहारिक धर्मादाय उपक्रम विकसित करणे आणि पारदर्शकतेने राबवणे.

actionVectors.title: Grassroots Needs Assessment
actionVectors.desc: Conducting empirical field surveys with local panchayats, schools, and families to identify critical intervention areas.

actionVectors.title: Technology & Skill Bootcamps
actionVectors.desc: Deploying modular skill labs, vernacular digital tablets, and IT curricula to make rural youth employment-ready.

actionVectors.title: Women SHG Enterprise Incubation
actionVectors.desc: Providing training in agro-processing, food packaging, quality control, and direct marketplace linkages for rural women.

actionVectors.title: Sanctuary-Grade Animal Welfare
actionVectors.desc: Operating safe shelter facilities with 24/7 veterinary healthcare, organic green fodder, and humane care standards.

actionVectors.title: Watershed & Afforestation Action
actionVectors.desc: Constructing check dams, rainwater harvesting systems, and planting indigenous drought-tolerant trees.

actionVectors.title: Transparent CSR Partnerships
actionVectors.desc: Collaborating with corporations and institutions under MCA CSR-1 Schedule VII with 100% auditable documentation.

guidingPrinciples: Zero private profit distribution; 100% reinvestment into charitable purposes
Statutory compliance under the Maharashtra Public Trusts Act and MCA guidelines
Empirical field record-keeping and verifiable beneficiary reporting
Preservation of beneficiary human dignity and respectful representation

values.title: Dignity
values.description: Every person deserves respect, empathy, and fair treatment.

values.title: Opportunity
values.description: We focus on creating sustainable pathways rather than only temporary relief.

values.title: Inclusion
values.description: Our programmes serve communities lawfully, equally, and without discrimination.

values.title: Integrity
values.description: All public resources and grants are managed with impeccable moral uprightness.

values.title: Accountability
values.description: Every project maintains auditable financial and beneficiary records.

values.title: Collaboration
values.description: Transformational social change requires partnerships with communities, government, and industry.

values.title: Sustainability
values.description: We engineer solutions that create enduring social, economic, and ecological value.

values.title: Transparency
values.description: Public disclosures, project milestones, and statutory reporting are clear and verifiable.
